_note: Rainbow spectrum and glitter motion (Lib/Rainbow), used when the caller's opts leave a value out. Times in seconds.

spectrum._note: hue turns per second the spectrum scrolls

glitter._note: rate_per_s sparkles a second, at most burst_max spawned in one frame; a sparkle lives life_s plus up to life_range_s more and spins up to spin_deg_per_s either way
